messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["yellow ferric oxide", "red ferric oxide NF", "FD&C Yellow #6 Aluminum Lake", "allergy to aspirin or yellow food dye", "check liquid is clear and colorless to slightly yellow", "continue holding until the yellow plunger rod stops moving and fills the viewing window", "tell your doctor if you take Adhansia - an allergy to aspirin or yellow food dye", "yellowing of skin or eyes", "titanium dioxide USP", "certain food dyes", "iron supplements", "yellowing of skin or whites of eyes", "contrast dyes", "chemical", "colloidal silicon dioxide", "Tirosint-Sol oral solution"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
